name: website-deploy
description: Deploy static websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent (inline JSON or tar.gz/zip). Every site lives at its own address, https://<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app/, and gets per-site KV, SQLite and file resources; legacy state, lists and private Submissions remain available on Simple Host for existing sites only, built-in server-side visitor analytics, and can be connected to your own custom domain — subdomain via CNAME or apex via A record. Pages and public lists are readable by anyone; visitors sign in with Google or an emailed code via the hosted auth.js before saving from a page, and a collection can be made private so only the owner reads it (orders, RSVPs, surveys); agents write with an API key anywhere. Bundles a builder skill (plan what to build) and a connect-domain skill. Choose a personal home page and curate its showcase with bio, pins and order.
